 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.FACILITY_ID END) n_active,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND b.FACILITY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN f.FACILITY_ID END) n_active_w_bal,
 LISTAGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.PRODUCT_CD END, ',') prods,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.COMMIT_AMT END) commit_active,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN b.DRAWN_AMT END) drawn,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN b.UNDRAWN_AMT END) undrawn,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND f.PRODUCT_CD='SBLC' THEN b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT END) sblc_amt,
 MAX(f.RISK_RATING) worst_rr, MAX(b.DPD) max_dpd
FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.CIF_NO=c.CIF_NO
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
WHERE c.CIF_NO IN ('0000041850','0000042498','0000041539','0000041642','0000042036','0000042083','0000042648','0000041002','0000042233','0000042657','0000042037','0000042452','0000041974','0000041022','0000041168')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1

sql.sql: SELECT SNAP_DT, PRODUCT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT TRADE_ID) trades, COUNT(DISTINCT ENTITY_ID) ents, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(MTM_AMT) mtm, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_ce, SUM(CASE WHEN MTM_AMT<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_mtm, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_ce, SUM(CASE WHEN ENTITY_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_ent FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT ORDER BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN MTM_AMT<0 AND CURRENT_EXPOSURE<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_mtm_nonzero_ce, SUM(CASE WHEN MTM_AMT>=0 AND CURRENT_EXPOSURE<>MTM_AMT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pos_mismatch, MIN(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) mn, MAX(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) mx FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT ENTITY_ID) ents, COUNT(CIF_REF) with_cif, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_REF) dist_cif, MIN(LEN(CIF_REF)) minlen, MAX(LEN(CIF_REF)) maxlen, SUM(CASE WHEN CIF_REF LIKE '%[^0-9]%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonnumeric, MIN(CIF_REF) mincif, MAX(CIF_REF) maxcif FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_NO) d, MIN(LENGTH(CIF_NO)) mnl, MAX(LENGTH(CIF_NO)) mxl, MIN(CIF_NO), MAX(CIF_NO), LISTAGG(DISTINCT CLIENT_STATUS, ',') st, LISTAGG(DISTINCT SEGMENT_CD, ',') seg FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT

SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF, e.ce, e.trades, e.notional FROM (SELECT ENTITY_ID, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, COUNT(*) trades, SUM(NOTIONAL_AMT) notional FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY ENTITY_ID HAVING SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) > 5000000) e LEFT JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID=e.ENTITY_ID ORDER BY e.ce DESC

SELECT f.FACILITY_STATUS, f.PRODUCT_CD, p.PRODUCT_FAMILY, COUNT(*) n, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) c, COUNT(PAYOFF_DT) po, COUNT(CHGOFF_DT) co FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.REF.PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_CD=f.PRODUCT_CD GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT CIF_NO, CLIENT_NM, SEGMENT_CD FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT WHERE CLIENT_NM ILIKE '%Fund%' OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE '%Capital Markets%' OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE 'Moorcroft%' OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE 'Brandvold%'

SELECT c.CIF_NO, c.CLIENT_NM, c.SEGMENT_CD, c.CLIENT_STATUS,
 COUNT(DISTINCT f.FACILITY_ID) n_fac_all,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.FACILITY_ID END) n_active,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND b.FACILITY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN f.FACILITY_ID END) n_active_w_bal,
 LISTAGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.PRODUCT_CD END, ',') prods,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.COMMIT_AMT END) commit_active,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN b.DRAWN_AMT END) drawn,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN b.UNDRAWN_AMT END) undrawn,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND f.PRODUCT_CD='SBLC' THEN b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT END) sblc_amt,
 MAX(f.RISK_RATING) worst_rr, MAX(b.DPD) max_dpd
FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.CIF_NO=c.CIF_NO
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
WHERE c.CIF_NO IN ('0000041850','0000042498','0000041539','0000041642','0000042036','0000042083','0000042648','0000041002','0000042233','0000042657','0000042037','0000042452','0000041974','0000041022','0000041168')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1
